title: Junior QA Tester
description:
We are looking for an enthusiastic Junior QA Tester to join our team on-site in Frankfurt and begin their journey in game development quality assurance.

As a Junior QA Tester, you'll work closely with experienced QA team members, designers, programmers, artists, and producers to help ensure our players have the best possible experience. You'll learn how games are tested throughout development, how quality issues are identified and reported, and how QA contributes to building great games.

What You'll Do

  • Execute assigned test cases and testing tasks under the guidance of senior team members.
  • Test new features, content, gameplay systems, and fixes throughout development.
  • Identify, reproduce, and document issues clearly and accurately.
  • Perform regression testing to verify fixes and ensure existing functionality remains stable.
  • Learn QA tools, workflows, and testing methodologies used throughout development.
  • Maintain accurate records of testing activity and results.
  • Communicate progress, questions, and blockers clearly to the QA team.
  • Participate in team meetings, playtests, and development discussions where appropriate.
  • Support the wider QA team in maintaining high quality standards across the project.

What You Bring

  • A passion for games and an interest in how they are developed.
  • Strong attention to detail and a willingness to learn.
  • Good written and verbal English communication skills.
  • A methodical approach to problem solving and investigation.
  • Ability to work effectively as part of a team.
  • Positive attitude, reliability, and eagerness to develop new skills.
  • Comfortable receiving feedback and applying it constructively.

Nice To Have (Not Required)

  • Previous experience in QA, game testing, customer support, or a similar role.
  • Familiarity with bug tracking tools or QA processes.
  • Knowledge of game development pipelines or production workflows.
  • Experience with game editors, modding tools, or technical hobbies.
  • Familiarity with Hunt: Showdown.
  • Basic scripting, coding, or technical troubleshooting knowledge.
  • Basic 3D modelling or games art pipelines

What You Can Expect From Us

Career Path

Your professional development is important to us, so we have laid out a career plan to help you progress towards your goals and objectives.

Relocation Support

We offer a relocation budget and full coverage of flights to Frankfurt for you and your family.

You can expect extensive assistance with visa, work permits, and communication with authorities during the relocation process, as well as help settling into Germany (e.g. setting up appointments with banks, government agencies, schools, landlords, finding apartments etc.).

Company Apartment

To help you get settled, we provide you with a fully furnished company apartment during your first three months in Frankfurt.

Public Transport Pass

Discover Frankfurt by bus, tram and metro – free of charge.

Gym Card

A healthy body is a healthy mind. We offer a membership at the premium gym chain Fitness First in Germany. Work out, join group fitness classes, or relax in the wellness facilities.

State-of-the-art Office

We’ve recently moved into a brand-new, modern office located in the heart of Frankfurt. Our new workspace is designed to inspire creativity and collaboration, with open areas, quiet zones, and top-tier facilities — all just steps away from public transport, restaurants, bars and cultural hotspots.

Hybrid Working

We believe in the value of in-person collaboration while also supporting flexibility. Our hybrid working model includes three days per week in the office and the option to work remotely up to two days per week, unless role-specific requirements or business needs require you to be on site.

Equal Opportunity & Inclusion

We’re building a workplace where everyone belongs. We welcome people of all backgrounds and identities and are proud to be a truly global team, with employees from over 42 countries contributing their ideas, cultures, and perspectives every day.

German Classes

Understanding the local culture will make your stay abroad more enjoyable, and Crytek supports that by offering German language courses for you and your family.

Events

Join us on our exciting company events, including new starter breakfasts, summer and winter parties, our annual trip to Gamescom in Cologne, and many more!

Vacation Days

At our Frankfurt office you can enjoy 24 days of vacation per year, and every 2 years you get 1 more (up to a maximum of 28 days). You will also have on average 10 public holidays on top of the days you take off.

Bei shoring.io bauen wir nicht einfach nur Apps – wir entwickeln digitale Marketing-Tech-Infrastruktur für den Handel von morgen. Von komplexen Flutter-Apps über performante Middleware bis hin zu Web-Integrationen in moderne E-Com-Engines: Unsere Kunden erwarten Exzellenz, und wir liefern sie. 


Damit das so bleibt, suchen wir einen QA Engineer (m/w/d), der/die bei uns nicht "nebenher" testet, sondern als zentraler Teil des Produktteams und als Gesicht zum Kunden unsere Qualitätsstandards maßgeblich mitgestaltet.


Du bist kein reiner Tester, sondern ein Quality Architect. 

Du siehst QA nicht als Checkliste, sondern als essenziellen Bestandteil unserer CI/CD-Pipelines.


Deine Mission bei shoring.io

  • Voll integrierter Teamplayer: Du bist kein Outsider, der Tickets abarbeitet. Du bist ein festes Mitglied in unseren agilen Produktteams. Deine Stimme zählt - von der Konzeption von Lösungen bis zum Release, bei jedem Sprint-Planung-Meeting und jedem Architektur-Entscheid.
  • Das Gesicht zum Kunden: Du vertrittst unsere Qualitätsansprüche direkt gegenüber dem Kunden. Du präsentierst Testergebnisse, berätst bei Release-Entscheidungen und schaffst durch Transparenz Vertrauen in unsere Arbeit.
  • QA-Strategie & Architektur: Du baust unsere Qualitätssicherung von Grund auf auf. Du definierst Prozesse, die unsere Entwicklungsgeschwindigkeit in unseren Flutter- und KMP-Projekten nachhaltig steigern.
  • Mobile & Web Testing: Du bist unser Experte für E2E-Tests. Du entwickelst automatisierte Test-Szenarien für komplexe Mobile-App-Flows und stellst die nahtlose Anbindung an E-Commerce- CRM- und Loyalty-Systeme sicher.
  • Test-Automation: Du treibst die Automatisierung voran. Du nutzt moderne Tools (z.B. Maestro, Appium, Cypress oder Playwright), um sicherzustellen, dass unsere Releases stabil und performant sind.
  • Qualitäts-Advocacy: Du bist der Ankerpunkt für Qualität in unseren agilen Squads. Du lebst "Quality First" und förderst eine Kultur, in der die Code-Qualität im Zentrum steht.


Das bringst du mit

  • Technik: Du hast fundierte Erfahrung im Testing komplexer Applikationen. Da wir primär auf Flutter setzen, ist Erfahrung im Bereich Mobile E2E-Tests (z.B. Firebase Test Lab, BrowserStack) ein riesiges Plus.
  • E-Commerce Know-how: Idealerweise hattest du bereits Berührungspunkte mit Handelsplattformen wie Vtex, Shopify oder Shopware und verstehst die typischen Workflows im E-Commerce/FMCG-Bereich.
  • Mindset: Du bist ein strukturierter Problem-Solver. Du verstehst, dass exzellente Qualität aus der Kombination von technischer Präzision und pragmatischen, agilen Prozessen entsteht.
  • Kommunikation: Du kannst technische Hürden klar benennen, bist ein verlässlicher Sparringspartner für unsere Kunden und Entwickler dabei behältst du in intensiven Release-Phasen den Überblick. Du sprichst Deutsch und Englisch verhandlungssicher.


Was wir dir bieten

  • Impact: Bei shoring.io gibt es kein "das war schon immer so". Du gestaltest unsere QA-Infrastruktur aktiv mit und setzt eigene Standards.
  • Hardware: Du hast Zugriff auf unser eigenes Device-Lab mit einer Vielzahl an Testgeräten direkt in unserem Büro in Schorndorf.
  • Flexibilität: Die Stelle ist in Vollzeit oder mit 80 % Pensum besetzbar. Wir leben eine hybride Kultur: 2–3 Tage die Woche arbeiten wir vor Ort in Schorndorf, den Rest der Zeit arbeitest du flexibel remote.
  • State-of-the-Art Tech & Growth: Arbeite mit Flutter und Kotlin Multiplatform. Wir fördern deine Entwicklung durch gezielte Weiterbildung (Zertifizierungen, Konferenzen).
  • Culture: Ein hochmotiviertes Team, flache Hierarchien und eine Umgebung, in der gute Ideen zählen.


Ready for the next step? Der Prozess ist bei uns so direkt wie unsere Kommunikation: Ein Call mit mir (Tobias Kern), eine Challenge, Team-Day – und los geht’s.

The Python Developer will be responsible for designing, architecting, and guiding the development of backend platforms and API services that power the enterprise Cutover capability. This role supports large-scale infrastructure upgrades, architectural transitions, and complex design changes by enabling reliable, automation-driven Cutover execution. The position requires deep expertise in Python, distributed system design, API frameworks, and event-driven backend services. As a key technical leader, the Python Developer will work closely with business stakeholders, Cutover and automation teams, UI engineers, and DevOps groups to deliver seamless, end-to-end Cutover solutions-from design and integration through controlled production execution.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of professional Python development with strong advanced object oriented design skills.
  • 8+ years architecting and developing backend APIs/services using Flask, Gunicorn, and production-grade Python frameworks.
  • 8+ years of experience with Python environment management, virtual environments, dependency handling, and PYPI package maintenance.
  • 8+ years working with Python development tools such as Jupyter, Eclipse, Spyder, or equivalent.
  • 8-10+ years of hands-on work in Linux environments.
  • 8+ years of experience with version control (Git/SVN) and CI/CD tooling (Jenkins, Ansible) for automated deployments.
  • Strong proficiency in bash scripting for automation and system orchestration.
  • Advanced experience with data preparation, Python data structures, and Pandas.
  • 8+ years of working with relational and NoSQL databases, including strong SQL fundamentals and ORM experience with SQLAlchemy.
  • Significant experience designing, deploying, and supporting enterprise-scale REST/SOAP web services.

    Desired Qualifications
  • Communication - Speaks clearly, concisely, and knows the audience.
  • Scheduling - Understands dependencies and the difference between critical path deliverables and those that are not. Understands the impacts of schedule delays on financials, risk, and strategy and can balance the need for escalation with non-impacting schedule misses and escalate appropriately when necessary or manage it independently when escalation is not needed.
  • Risk Management - Understands risk criteria and always considers risk but is not crippled by risk adversity. Balances the need to act with the need to be risk adverse
  • Critical Thinking - Has the ability to analyze complex data from multiple sources and objectively make reasoned judgment.
  • Task Management - Understands the work that needs to get done, the resources completing the work, and aligns tasks to the right people, even if the right person occasionally isn't in that particular role
  • Strong familiarity with project management software, such as Microsoft Project.
  • Proven track record of successfully managing multiple projects at various stages of the project life cycle.

Job Description

Job Title: Python Developer

Job Type: Contract

Location: Remote

Job Summary: In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and optimize REST and GraphQL endpoints for scalable APIs.
  • Drive data validation, error handling, and security best practices within backend services.
  • Plan and execute database migrations, optimizations, and schema changes as needed.
  • Actively test new AI-powered models in Cursor, providing actionable feedback via incident reports, bug traces, and screenshots.
  • Participate in 4-day intensive testing bursts, exploring how AI models impact real coding workflows.
  • Engage thoughtfully with the research team in a dedicated Slack channel to discuss findings and propose improvements.
  • Submit detailed post-burst surveys, delivering insights on model performance and developer experience.

Required Skills And Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional experience as a backend developer, with strong expertise in Python.
  • Proficient in building and maintaining RESTful and GraphQL APIs.
  • Advanced understanding of backend data validation, error handling, and API security.
  • Hands-on experience with database migrations, performance tuning, and schema design.
  • Extensive use of AI tools for coding; familiarity with Cursor is highly desirable.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with a knack for clear incident and bug reporting.
  • Proven ability to thrive in fast-paced, confidential, and collaborative remote environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Visible contributions to open source (e.g., GitHub stars or contributions).
  • Experience designing or evaluating experimental tooling and developer workflows.
  • Demonstrated enthusiasm for AI advancements in software development.

description:
Model: Full-time, Onsite

Scope: Fully Employed

Location: Derbyshire

Overview:

We are seeking a motivated Junior Embedded Software Engineer to support the development of embedded systems. This role offers an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on experience in software and hardware integration while contributing to the delivery of high-quality technical solutions.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain embedded software using C and C++
  • Support integration of software with hardware systems
  • Assist in debugging, testing, and validation of embedded applications
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including hardware and systems engineering
  • Produce and maintain clear technical documentation
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of development processes


Requirements:

  • 2+ years of experience in Embedded Systems.
  • Proficiency in C and C++
  • Basic understanding of embedded systems and software development principles
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
  • Good written and verbal communication skills
  • Degree in Computer Science, Electronics, or a related field


Desirable:

  • Familiarity with Linux environments
  • Knowledge of communication protocols (e.g., UART, SPI, I2C, CAN)
  • Experience with debugging tools and version control systems
